mapper.insert: insert into notification_outbox (event_key, recipient_id, type, title, body, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at) values (#{eventKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recipientId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{type,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{body,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{retryCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{nextRetryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select id, event_key, recipient_id, type, title, body, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at from notification_outbox where status = 'PENDING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= now()) order by id asc limit #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.update: update notification_outbox set status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, retry_count = #{retryCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
